project: Detecting Misinterpreted but Genuine Citations through Automated Claim Verification
study_type: retrospective post-hoc evaluation of frozen predictions; not independent prospective calibration
analysis_status: NOT_RUN; only source-file integrity checked; abstention outcomes not calculated

data.dev_usage: descriptive file QA only; no threshold fitting or calibration
data.gold_label_rule: use explicit evidence label if present; otherwise provisional NEI; sensitivity excludes provisional NEI

policies.B1: uniform random select same integer k at 80% coverage
policies.P: accept highest max_probability k cases, no fitted threshold

random_control.method: independent without-replacement subsets of size k from 606 cases using numpy.random.default_rng(42)
random_control.exact_expected_selective_error: full-sample empirical error rate at any k
random_control.simulation_purpose: sanity-check/distribution; Monte Carlo mean reported separately

uncertainty.resample: N test rows with replacement; recalculate full-sample risk, max-probability top-k selective risk; difference
uncertainty.interpretation: descriptive only; no verified article cluster, potential model-selection contamination

primary_metric.name: selective_error_rate
primary_metric.definition: incorrect accepted predictions divided by accepted predictions
primary_metric.success_rule: effect>=0.03 and bootstrap percentile CI lower bound >0; otherwise negative/inconclusive
primary_metric.note: 3 percentage-point practical threshold, not literature-derived; retrospective effect only

secondary.aurc: mean of prefix error rates after score ranking, k=1..N (discrete full-range AURC, lower better)
secondary.classwise: accepted count, wrong count, precision and recall by class on accepted cases; zero_division=0

confidence_scores.margin: top1 probability minus top2 probability; descending

secondary.sensitivity: exclude all rows with provisional NEI, rescale k at 80% on retained test subset of 556 rows; repeat main comparison

governance.evaluation_changes: append decision with date, reason, effect on comparability; no silent changes
